risk.formula: central = V(1 - prod(1 - p_i LGF_i T_i)): exact expectation under independence + best-path transmission; dependence-free bounds [V max p_i h_i, V min(1, sum p_i h_i)]; band low = independence at low parameters, high = union bound at high parameters (any correlation). Paths are SUMMED over a vault's allocations (each share of assets is exposed once; capped at 100%).

parameters.classes: observed = measured on public data for this asset; calibrated = public base rate adjusted by metadata; protocol-derived = read from contracts; scenario_assumption = expert weight with a band; not_used = carried elsewhere (no double counting)

risk.loss_bounds: 0 <= loss <= value_usd (no liability beyond the shares)

exit.basis: USD at the deposit-asset price (EURCV $1.11913); same horizon 30d

comparison_basis.rule: compared terms share one size: loss avoided = EL x w, forgone carry = carry x w, execution = simulated cost of that same tranche; residual EL x (1 - w) stays exposed (its later exit is uncertain)
comparison_basis.why: the whole position is executable now by a simulated route

exit.hypothetical: value_usd is a HYPOTHETICAL exposure converted to vault shares at the pinned block's share price; it is not proof that anyone holds these shares
exit.unavailable_liquidity_note: blocked/deferred = amount no SIMULATED route can withdraw now (not a loss)

ordinary.what: idle + liquidity adapter market (VaultV2) / withdrawQueue (V1): plain redeem

force_deallocate.what: VaultV2.multicall([forceDeallocate(other markets)..., redeem]) in one transaction

capacity.rule: idle + min(liquidity-adapter supply, free liquidity) of the liquidityData market (VaultV2 exit path)
capacity.contract_max_redeem_note: VaultV2 maxWithdraw/maxRedeem return 0 by design: not used as a limit

simulation_partial.method: eth_call redeem() with a state override on the share balance of 0xdEaD (read-only, no tx)

simulation_force_deallocate.method: eth_call VaultV2.multicall([forceDeallocate(...)..., redeem(...)]) with a state override on the share balance of 0xdEaD (read-only, no tx)

exit.execution_note: execution = gas + friction of the compared route at its simulated size; friction includes any forceDeallocate penalty (paid in shares)
exit.exit_fee_note: no withdrawal fee in VaultV2 / MetaMorpho; performance and management fees are already in the share price (reflected in the net APY)

carry.formula: V x net APY 2.57% (sum share_m x supply APY_m x (1 - perf fee) - mgmt fee, on-chain IRM) x 30/365
carry.note: forgone yield if redeemed and left un-deployed (reference 0%: assumption). Past/current APY is not a promise; band +-50%. Counted on the EXIT side. Token incentives (rewards_api, Morpho API) are NOT counted: off-chain programme, paid in other tokens, can stop at any time (conservative for STAY).

decision.margin_convention: margin_usd = expected_loss_usd - (execution_cost_usd + carry_usd), all on comparison_basis (same size w); > 0: staying costs more on central values (Phase 0.5 convention)
decision.rule: EXIT if loss_low > exit_high; STAY if loss_high < exit_low; else REVIEW (lean = central comparison). Stale / replayed / approximated inputs force REVIEW. A partial / zero / unknown exit downgrades EXIT to REVIEW (never an executable 100% EXIT); an exit is executable only through a route whose simulation succeeded (ordinary redeem or forceDeallocate multicall). Partial: every compared term is for the executable tranche.
decision.explanation: REVIEW (uncertain): the estimate does not support a firm decision. Staying: expected loss $656 [$112-$3,519] over 30d. Exiting: execution $0.11 + forgone carry $2,109 = $2,109 [$1,055-$3,164]. Margin (loss - exit side) = $-1,454: exiting costs more on central values (point verdict STAY). Withdrawal feasibility: full_via_force_deallocate ($1,000,000 immediately). assumptions: value_usd is a hypothetical exposure: converted to vault shares at the pinned share price; no holding is claimed
collateral 'failure' = 50% jump drop (no time to liquidate before it); suppliers lose only the bad debt left after on-chain liquidations (Morpho Blue liquidation math, LIF from LLTV)

debt missing from the indexed borrower list (Morpho API, largest positions): central = the indexed borrowers' bad-debt rate shrunk toward the at-LLTV worst case by the unindexed share of the debt (no list -> at the LLTV); band = no bad debt .. all at the LLTV

oracle failure = collateral mis-priced by 40%, direction unknown. Over-pricing: free liquidity drained at once (no lag), positions liquidated after correction with the liquidator keeping the incentive (low end: full recovery). Under-pricing: liquidations at the false price; suppliers lose only the debt left once all collateral is seized (zero for a mild error, otherwise as a real drop). Central = mean of the two directions; band = milder .. worse direction
vault contracts / curator and Morpho Blue share one Morpho protocol prior (x0.5 each, Phase 0.5 split); chain prior 0.5%/y
deposit asset depeg and EUR/USD are decision-neutral (held after redeeming too): shown as context / what-if
carry = on-chain net APY (supply APY of each market x share, net of fees) over the horizon, reference 0%, band +-50%
ordinary withdrawal capacity is shared with every other depositor and can change every block
probabilities are horizon-scaled annual base rates (DefiLlama), not forecasts; this is not investment advice
